mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_info (order_no, product_id, buyer_id, seller_id, amount, status, remark, meeting_time, meeting_place) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{meetingTime}, #{meetingPlace})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_info WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.sql: SELECT o.*, p.title AS product_title, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = o.product_id ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS product_cover, CASE WHEN o.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN s.nickname ELSE b.nickname END AS counterpart_name, CASE WHEN o.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN s.avatar ELSE b.avatar END AS counterpart_avatar FROM order_info o JOIN product p ON p.id = o.product_id JOIN `user` s ON s.id = o.seller_id JOIN `user` b ON b.id = o.buyer_id
